title: Application login failure
keywords: login authentication 500 error backend deployment server error
checks: Review application logs for errors around the time the issue started.
Check whether the latest deployment changed authentication settings.
Verify that the authentication service and required dependencies are healthy.
suggested_action: Investigate application logs and validate the latest deployment before attempting a rollback.

title: Database connection failure
keywords: database sql connection timeout query failed database unavailable
symptoms: Queries fail or data does not load
checks: Check whether the database service is reachable.
Review database connection settings and connection pool usage.
Inspect database logs for authentication, capacity, or query errors.
suggested_action: Collect database health and connection error details before changing database settings.

title: Network or DNS connectivity issue
keywords: network dns connection refused timeout cannot connect api hostname
symptoms: A service cannot reach another service
Hostname resolution or connection attempts fail
checks: Verify the hostname and DNS configuration.
Check connectivity to the target service.
Review relevant network and service logs.
suggested_action: Identify the failing connection path and escalate network changes to the responsible team.

title: Slow application performance
keywords: slow latency performance lagging dashboard api response delay
symptoms: Pages take too long to load
API responses are slower than expected
checks: Measure response times for affected endpoints.
Inspect slow database queries and application resource usage.
Compare current performance with a known healthy period.
suggested_action: Gather performance measurements before making configuration or capacity changes.

title: Suspicious account activity
keywords: security password unauthorized hacked suspicious login security breach
symptoms: An account may have been accessed without authorization
checks: Preserve relevant authentication and security logs.
Follow the organization's security incident response procedure.
Escalate promptly to the authorized security team.
suggested_action: Escalate for human security review. Do not perform account or system changes automatically.
